description: Adaptation Workbook is a decision-support tool listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Northern Institute of Applied Climate Science; USDA Northern Forests Climate Hub; USFS | State, Private, and Tribal Forestry. The Adaptation Workbook walks land management professionals and land owners through a structured process to help them consider the potential effects of climate change on forests, urban forests, and agricultural lands. It helps users design management, stewardship, and conservation actions to prepare for changing conditions while meeting their goals. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Changing Seasons, Extreme Heat, Flooding – General, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Natural Areas and Wildlife, Property. The listed link gives the project or repository page; nothing was installed or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
